entry.title: Proof-of-work based signet faucet
entry.summary: The discussion revolves around a specific application of bitaxe-level hardware for mining activities related to the Bitcoin Signet. The user has initiated testing on the platform hosted at [inquisition.bitcoin-signet.net](http://inquisition.bitcoin-signet.net) utilizing port 3333, with the configuration set to use a signet address as the user identifier. This setup has been operational with an approximate hash rate of 0.5 TH/s over a span of several hours. During this test phase, although there is uncertainty about whether a block has been successfully solved, the system has consistently generated frequent payouts to the designated address. This indicates a positive preliminary outcome for the mining strategy employed in this scenario.
